title: Benchmark design redirects biomedical discovery: reproducibility package
description: Pre-submission reproducibility package for a biomedical AI benchmarking study linking benchmark construction to model selection, hypothesis identity, later BioGRID evidence, and independent ChEMBL evidence. The package includes frozen protocols, negative controls, seed-level outputs, provenance, source-data tables, and a leakage-free contemporary-model challenge. It is not a statement of peer review or acceptance and does not claim universal superiority of structural neutralization.
